projectDescription: The Login Page template provides a clean, user-friendly interface designed for quick and secure user authentication. With fields for entering email or username and password, along with a prominent login button, it ensures a smooth login experience.

A portfolio landing page is a personal or professional web page designed to showcase an individual’s skills, experience, and creative work. It typically features a clean and organized layout with sections for project highlights, a short bio or introduction, technical or creative skills, and contact information.

A Discord landing page is a focused web page designed to introduce users to a specific Discord server or community, highlighting its purpose, features, and benefits. It typically includes a brief description of what the server offers—such as gaming discussions, study groups, tech support, or fan communities—along with engaging visuals, server rules or guidelines, and a clear invitation link to join.
